feature.name: Мапа подій
feature.viewer: 20–30-year-olds in their first months in a new city, whose week is a route from home to work and back
feature.task: open the map, see what is on around them this weekend, pick an event
feature.before: the first month in a new city is «дім → робота → дім»: the city is all around, but none of it is visible
feature.after: the map shows what is on nearby, so the city starts to feel like theirs

music.note: calm.m4a; its lift (8.03 s in the track) lands on the opening at 5.15

beats.line: щойно переїхали? — дім → робота → дім — а місто — поруч
beats.picture: motion design, no UI: two violet stops «дім» and «робота» land, a route draws between them and a white dot slides back and forth along it; three zero pills («знайомих у місті: 0», «улюблених місць: 0», «планів на пʼятницю: 0») rise under it and «щойно переїхали?» lands in the caption band; the pills dissolve and the verdict «дім → робота → дім» (Unbounded 900, an itinerary) lands one stop per arrival of the dot; the routine steps back and blurs away; «а місто — поруч» assembles word by word, the lines part around a seam of light, and the seam opens to the whole frame onto a district of the Kyiv map
beats.take: calm: soft power3/sine eases, words rise out of a blur, no smears or slams; the verdict is synced to the dot's arrivals; the opening window holds the phone's screen at exactly the proof's first camera, so the cut into the phone is invisible
beats.exit: match cut: the window is the phone's screen at zoom 4 on a district; the proof opens on the same frame

beats.line: відкриваєш мапу · бачиш, що відбувається довкола · і місто стає твоїм
beats.picture: map-kyiv-weekend: the camera pulls back from the district to the whole phone, the city full of pins; a slow drift while soft rings breathe out of a few pins; then a push onto the event card «Вистава «Будьте як вдома» · У СУБОТУ · 17:00 · АФІША», with «Знайдено подій: 123» left in the top fade
beats.take: one real screen, three camera moves (pull back, drift, push), all power2/sine in-out; one caption per move; no taps
ui: pull back from zoom 4 on the centre to the full phone
drift 1 → 1.05 with rings on five pins
push onto the bottom event card (zoom 2.2)
beats.carrier: the event card lifts out of the phone while the phone falls away

beats.picture: the event card sits alone on the ground, and the «Поряд» icon and name arrive under it
beats.take: inverse zoom for the brand reveal
beats.carrier: the «Поряд» lockup travels up into the end card while the card and line leave left

beats.line: скільки ти вже в новому місті? 👇
beats.picture: the «Поряд» lockup over «твоє місто. нарешті видно.», «безкоштовно» and the App Store badge
beats.take: end card; the official badge is a hard cut and never moves
